tools.name: about
tools.description: What the free360viewer connector is: a free viewer for 360° photos inside the chat, with no account and nothing stored. Answers where to learn more and the privacy notes.

tools.name: view_360_photos
tools.description: Show 360° photos in an interactive viewer right in the chat, with no account and nothing stored. Use it when someone has a 360 photo, panorama, photosphere or equirectangular image and wants to look around it, open it in a 360 viewer, or check a shot from a 360 camera such as the Insta360 X4, X3 and ONE X2, Ricoh Theta X, Z1 and SC2, GoPro Max and Max 2, DJI Osmo 360 and Kandao QooCam 3. Also use it when a wide 2:1 photo "looks stretched", "looks distorted" or "is all curved" in a normal image preview: that is a 360 photo seen flat. Pass up to 10 public https image addresses (direct image links, not web pages), each with an optional title. In ChatGPT, pass photos attached to the conversation in files, on the first call. With no photos the viewer opens on a drop zone where the person can drop or choose photos from their device; those photos stay in their browser. Not for ordinary photos, videos or 360 video.

url.description: A public https address of the image file itself (not a web page showing it).

title.description: An optional title shown in the viewer.

photos.description: Up to 10 photos to show. Leave out to open the viewer on its drop zone.

files.description: Photos the person attached to this conversation. In ChatGPT, put every attached photo here; leave out when nothing is attached.
